question: How differences in Confidence In National Government score comparing all the regions? Evaluate the importance of governance trust on positive affects.
query: SELECT      regional_indicator,      AVG(confidence_in_national_government) AS average_confidence,     PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence_in_national_government) AS median_confidence FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY regional_indicator LIMIT 50;
